inner_atom_control: Exact symbolic removal of r0,r3,r4,r5 leaves the same dust action on P+A for every history. Hence class probabilities conditioned on the inner atom cannot depend on g0/gplus.
gravity_phase_record_blindness: Exact: each orthogonally recorded class has constant F4, so exp(iF4) cancels from every complete 2x2 Kraus effect, all record contrasts and the failure completion. The frozen experiment does not test gravitational-action phase interference.
